verdict.rationale: GitHub's own marketing claims it updates vulnerable dependencies with fixes for breaking changes (github-docs-6). It also claims to reduce application vulnerabilities with security campaigns and Copilot Autofix (github-docs-14, github-docs-5), and to detect and block leaked secrets via push protection (github-docs-7, github-docs-15). Together these cover both halves of the story. However, the evidence is only one-line marketing copy, and automatic scanning on its own is implied rather than spelled out. missing for 10: in-depth docs on automatic dependency vulnerability alerts and code scanning configuration (what is scanned, triggers, supported languages and ecosystems), independent or hands-on corroboration.
